text: We bow to Sri Krishna, the son of Vasudeva, who destroyed Kamsa and Chanura, who brought supreme joy to Devaki Devi — the teacher of the whole world.
Remembering Satyabhama Devi, who stood beside Sri Krishna when Narakasura was slain, offer your namaskaram.
By the grace of Sri Krishna Paramatma, taking Satyabhama Devi's courage as your example, pray for a good mind, courage and the well-being of your family.
